caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical object positioned centrally within a rectangular frame. The object has a slightly flared base and a broader top, both of which feature decorative edging; the top edge is adorned with a pattern of rounded, drop-like forms, while the bottom edge has a ribbed or fluted design. The surface of the object is shaded in grayscale, giving it a metallic or smooth appearance with areas of light and dark to suggest dimension and curvature. The drawing is rendered on a light beige background with darker yellowed areas, particularly in the top right corner. The rectangular border of the drawing is made with fine pencil lines, and the lower right corner bears the artist’s signature and the year “1962” written in small lettering.
title: Silver Salt Trencher
